description_for_human: Browse the free Developer Marketplace and post your own listings.
description_for_model: Browse approved products on the Digital Underground Developer Marketplace (public, no auth) and create, update and check the review status of the user's own listings (requires the user's API key, Bearer duk_...). New listings always wait for human approval. Only submit real products the user owns, with accurate claims. MCP server: https://digitalundergroundstore.com/mcp
